implementationRules: Do not build a runtime JSON UI generator.
Do not create UI only during Play Mode.
Do not rely on Resources.Load during Play Mode as the primary flow.
Do not attach a runtime builder to a Bootstrap GameObject and stop there.
Do not edit .unity YAML as raw text.
Build or update a UnityEditor API based Editor Scene Baker.
Target Scene is required.
The generated Unity Editor Scene Baker must not guess the scene.
If the specified scene does not exist, abort.
If multiple scenes match the given name, abort.
Only bake into the exact scene specified by the user or into a scene manually selected by the user in the Baker window.
The exported JSON is the single source of truth for the Baker.
Save this JSON to Assets/JsonCanvas/Resources/UiCanvasSpec.json.
Add or update Assets/JsonCanvas/Editor/JsonCanvasSceneBakerWindow.cs.
Provide the Unity menu Tools/Json Canvas/Open Scene Baker.
The Baker must let the user select JSON Spec and Target Scene.
The Baker must let the user select Canvas Target Mode: UseExistingCanvas, DeleteExistingAndCreateNew, CreateNewCanvas, AbortIfCanvasExists.
The Baker must let the user select Existing SafeAreaRoot Handling: ReuseExisting, DeleteAndRecreate, AbortIfExists.
Bake Canvas To Scene must create real UGUI GameObjects in the selected Unity scene hierarchy.
Generated UI must be visible in the Hierarchy before Play Mode.
Call EditorSceneManager.MarkSceneDirty after Bake.
If Save Scene After Bake is enabled, call EditorSceneManager.SaveScene.
panel.id is data only and must not be used as a Unity GameObject name.
Unity GameObject names must use panel.hierarchyName.
Create hierarchy from panel.hierarchyPath and generatedUnityRectTransform.resolvedHierarchyPath.
In SplitGameViewAndCanvas mode, prefer resolvedHierarchyPath.
Canvas name is Canvas_Main when a new Canvas is created.
Create SafeAreaRoot under Canvas_Main or the selected Canvas.
CanvasScaler must use Scale With Screen Size for newly created Canvas objects.
If viewportSettings.mode is SplitGameViewAndCanvas, create GameViewRoot and OverlayRoot.
Place GameViewRoot using viewportSettings.gameViewRect.
OverlayRoot must fill the full Canvas.
Panels with viewportSpace GameView go under GameViewRoot.
Panels with viewportSpace Canvas go under OverlayRoot.
Initial layout must use generatedUnityRectTransform entries matching selectedScreenMode.
Apply unityRectTransform.authoritative.anchorMin, anchorMax, pivot, offsetMin, offsetMax.
Do not use debugPreview as actual RectTransform values.
Do not use anchoredPosition or sizeDelta for panel placement.
Do not reinterpret RectTransform from anchorPreset names.
layoutByMode is source data for mode switching; authoritative RectTransform wins for initial Bake.
If uiScaleSettings.applyTo.panelRects is false, do not apply UI Scale to GameViewRoot, OverlayRoot, or Panel RectTransforms.
UI Scale applies to internal UI elements only.
SlotGroup cell, spacing, and padding must prefer computedSlotLayout.
Each Panel must receive a CanvasGroup.
visibleCondition controls initial CanvasGroup alpha, interactable, and blocksRaycasts.
zIndex controls sibling order under the same parent.
If slotGroups is empty, do not instantiate SlotTemplates.
slotTemplates are global definitions and are instantiated only when a SlotGroup references them.
If slotGroup.layoutType is Grid, use GridLayoutGroup.
If slotGroup.layoutType is Horizontal, use HorizontalLayoutGroup and LayoutElement preferred sizes on slots.
If slotGroup.layoutType is Vertical, use VerticalLayoutGroup and LayoutElement preferred sizes on slots.
If slotGroup.scrollable is true, create ScrollRect, Viewport, and Content.
slotTemplateId must exactly match slotTemplates.id.

generatedUnityRectTransform.layoutInterpretation: 1920x1080 Canvas 기준 좌측 상단에 위치하며, 약 384px x 540px 크기입니다. 전체 폭이 아니라 일부 영역만 차지합니다. 현재 rect 기준으로는 TopLeft 배치에 가깝습니다.

metadata.anchorPresetNote: anchorPreset matches the current normalized rect: TopLeft.

unityRectTransform.note: Use authoritative values for implementation. debugPreview values are for validation only.
